preconditions.description: Attacker must have some BNRG tokens to approve (can be minimal amount)
Contract must not be in Locked state (should be Restricted or Unlocked)

exploit_hint: The approve function is vulnerable to a race condition where a spender can front-run approval changes. Attack strategy: 1) As token owner, approve spender for amount X. 2) Spender monitors mempool for new approval transaction for amount Y (where Y < X). 3) Spender front-runs the new approval by calling transferFrom to use the old allowance X before it's reduced to Y. 4) After the new approval sets allowance to Y, spender can still use Y, effectively getting X+Y total tokens. Execute two rapid transactions: first transferFrom using old allowance, then another transferFrom using new allowance.
